snippet.title: Cake Bash // Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/971690/Cake_Bash

Fight to be the tastiest cake in Cake Bash! A frantic four player party game where adorable drawn-to-life cakes beat the crumbs out of each other.

👥 Players: Single Player, Online PvP, Shared/Split Screen PvP, Shared Split Screen
🛠️ Developer:  High Tea Frog
📚 Publisher:  Coatsink
📅 Early Release Date: Dec 19, 2018
📅 Release Date: Oct 14, 2020
🎯 Genre: Action, Casual, Indie
